debrief db-021
1) the actor s-p-o-o-f-e-d the f-a-c-e-s-c-a-n with a p-r-i-n-t-e-d m-a-s-k and left a r-e-c-o-r-d in the l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the m-u-l-t-i-f-a-c-t-o-r a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-a-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the actor u-s-e-d a s-i-l-i-c-o-n f-i-n-g-e-r on the s-c-a-n-n-e-r and left a m-a-t-c-h e-n-t-r-y in the d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the l-i-v-e-n-e-s-s d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k
3) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d a f-a-l-s-e e-m-p-l-o-y-e e-n-t-r-y in the h-r-s-y-s-t-e-m and left a g-i-v-e-n i-d in the d-i-r-e-c-t-o-r-y while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
4) the actor c-l-o-n-e-d the b-a-d-g-e s-i-g-n-a-l with a r-f-i-d tag and left a s-w-i-p-e r-e-c-o-r-d in the g-a-t-e l-o-g while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-t-i-p-a-s-s-b-a-c-k c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n
5) the actor i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d f-a-k-e e-n-t-r-i-e-s into the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l and left a f-a-l-s-e t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p in the r-e-p-o-r-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-r-a-i-l i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k
